text: The epistemological capacity to understand quality, risk, and consequence by bearing exposure to outcomes is precisely what AI systems lack, and no computational advance can produce it independently; the capacity must be institutionally constructed.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, AI's Mother's Instinct Engineered Consequence Emergent Ethics and the Institutional Trajectory Toward Agentic Alignment (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6244278
